title: Cognition buys Poke to bring a more conversational style to Devin
friendlyTitle: Devin’s maker buys Poke to make AI agents easier to talk to
summary: Cognition has acquired Poke, an assistant designed to feel natural over text, in a deal TechCrunch reports values the startup in the low nine figures. Poke’s interaction design is expected to influence Cognition’s Devin coding agent.
friendlySummary: Cognition bought the friendly text assistant Poke and plans to bring some of its conversation design into the Devin coding agent.
whyItMatters: Agent competition is moving beyond model scores toward communication, trust and how well a system keeps users oriented during long tasks. Businesses evaluating agents should test hand-offs, explanations and error recovery alongside coding output.
friendlyWhyItMatters: An agent is more useful when people understand what it is doing and can correct it easily. Test communication and recovery from mistakes, not only the final code.
